messages:
elaine: FYI the visiting artist Marco (marco_art) is dropping by at 2pm to hang a short string of paper lanterns in the north corridor and bring a small vintage crate of glass beads. Hell be here ~45 mins. Can we print a temp badge and sort safe storage for the crate? :lantern:
frontdesk: Sounds good. We can print a visitor badge on arrival. Important: no open flames near paper lanterns  we need to advise him to use battery LED lights only. We'll also need him to sign the artwork dropoff form.
marco_art: Hi all! Yes, battery LEDs only, Ill bring AA battery packs. Crate is about 12x8x6 and marked fragile. Ill need a small ladder and a helper to hold the garland while I fix it.
facilities: I can bring a small two-step ladder and a pair of gloves. Ill meet him at 2. Also have a rolling dolly if crate is heavy.
sophie: Can we keep the crate in the art closet while he installs? That keeps it off the floor and out of the walkway.
frontdesk: Art closet works. We'll leave a sticky labelled "Marco  lanterns & beads". If crate has loose glass beads put them in the sealed box we keep in the closet.
badge-bot: temp badge printed: "Visitor - Marco (artist)" (expires 15:00).
elaine: Thanks @badge-bot. Seating for Marco while he waits: small meetup room or the bench by the printer? He prefers a quiet corner.
frontdesk: Small meetup room is currently booked; bench by the printer has a power outlet and is quieter mid-afternoon. We'll reserve it and post a sign.
marco_art: Bench is fine, thanks. Also, can someone help me hold the ladder for a minute? Two people would be ideal.
facilities: I'll be there with the ladder and gloves. @sophie can you assist for the hanging?
sophie: Yep happy to help.
elaine: Safety note: please no glitter or loose confetti near the plants. Facilities, can the janitor check the corridor after the install?
facilities: I'll ask janitorial to sweep the area at 3pm.
frontdesk: Also heads-up to the team: allergy note  some lanterns are scented (light citrus). We'll post a small sign: "Visitor install in progress  scented items present" so people with sensitivities know.
elaine: Great. Poll for hospitality: tea or bottled water for Marco? :tea: :droplet:
marco_art: Water please.
frontdesk: We'll offer water and print the badge on arrival. Sticky note with art closet location left at the desk. See you at 2pm.
elaine: Thanks everyone  appreciate the quick coord!
